summary: Encoding used for final image bytes: PNG, JPEG, or WebP. The choice affects alpha-channel support, file size, and whether output compression can be applied; it does not change the requested image dimensions.
combines: `background: transparent` requires PNG or WebP because JPEG cannot carry an alpha channel.
`output_compression` applies only to JPEG and WebP. It has no effect on PNG output.
Lixpi fixes the format to PNG so the settlement and rendition pipeline receives a lossless, transparency-compatible source.
note: Fixed to PNG by the image pipeline; required for transparent output compatibility.
